text:
vuln-bot: Automated alert: multiple low->high severity advisories affecting runtime deps used by inference clusters: vLLM, FlashAttention kernels, protobuf, sentencepiece. See https://vuln.example/1845 for details
sarah.w: Saw this — notes show protobuf CVE-2026-0452 (info leak), sentencepiece memory bug CVE-2026-0789 (crash/possible overflow), and a kernel race in flashattention builds that could corrupt kv-cache under load.
kai: Can we get a matrix of which services use the effected versions? I think Hosted runs vllm 0.8.x pinned, Dedicated uses custom Triton images, Private depends vary.
matt: Quick mapping: hosted-api -> vLLM 0.8.2 + proto 3.21.9, dedicated-gpus -> Triton 23.11 + flash-kernel v1.4.1, private-onprem templates reference sentencepiece 0.1.96. I can paste a short grep if useful.
priya: Important: sentencepiece crash is exploitable only on crafted input; still high prio for public endpoints. Hosted chat endpoints accept user text.
jen: Proposal: triage risk -> hotfix path for hosted (patch vLLM/protobuf), scheduled build for Triton/flashattention with kernel reorder fix, and coordinated patch windows for Private with customer notices.
sarah.w: Agree. Prioritization: 1) hosted (customer-facing public endpoints) 2) Dedicated (SLA) 3) Private (notify and provide patched artifacts). Assign owners?
kai: I'll own Hosted rollout. Plan: bump vLLM to 0.8.3 (upstream has protobuf bump), rebuild runtime image, run smoke + adversarial fuzzer for sentencepiece inputs, then canary on 3% traffic. ETA 6h for image + tests.
matt: I'll do Triton image rebuild for Dedicated. Need to recompile FlashAttention with race fix patch from vendor (PR #347). Will run throughput benchmarks after build. ETA 24-36h due to long GPU perf tests.
priya: I'll coordinate Private customers: prepare advisory template, include mitigations (input sanitization, rate-limits) and provide patched images/artifacts when ready.
jen: Security asks to add audit logging for proto deserialization errors and enable strict input size limits on public routes as immediate mitigation. Also enable KMS key rotation event logging for any model artifacts updated during rollouts.
vuln-bot: Added ticket SEC-2026-401 in tracker and linked CVE pages.
deploy-bot: Staging deploy created for kai: r=canary-vllm-2026-03-20-001. Use flag --enable-proto-strict for tests.
sarah.w: Risk notes: watch for perf regression from protobuf bump (some users saw +2-6% CPU). If >10% we fallback to older proto build + runtime sandboxing. Keep SLO owners in loop.
kai: Will instrument token-level latency and CPU per-replica; I'll add dashboard slice and alert if 95th > baseline + 10%.
matt: Also note Triton image change may affect Dedicated autoscale thresholds. I'll coordinate with infra to adjust.
priya: Customer comms draft: short summary, impact, ETA for patched artifacts, recommended mitigations. I'll share in #customer-notices channel once reviewed.
sarah.w: OK actionable summary: Kai -> hosted patch & canary (6h). Matt -> Triton/flash rebuild & perf (24-36h). Priya -> customer notices + private artifacts. Jen -> audit logging + KMS rotation logging. Everyone add test vectors to SEC-2026-401. Ping here when first staging pass is green. :thumbsup:
